meta.system: Dấu Việt Global — Map Marker & Spatial Identity System

principles.role: spatial discovery utility, not a second brand logo
principles.base: map markers use a restrained pointer/container with Phase 04 semantic inner glyphs
principles.color: Phase 02 colors are supplementary; shape/glyph/state carry meaning
principles.density: progressive disclosure by zoom; avoid marker carpet
principles.time: historical/time filtering changes state/context, not just hue

marker_geometry.inner_glyph: 20px at default; 16px micro at compact; 24px at featured
marker_geometry.safe_area: inner glyph centered above pointer tip; no glyph enters lower anchor zone

states.selected: 1.12–1.18 scale + stronger outline/halo + semantic glyph retained
states.featured: 40px visual + editorial emphasis, not gold-only meaning

clusters.visual: bounded circle/soft polygon, not a branded logo
clusters.meaning: cluster size/count carries density; color may indicate layer but never replaces count

zoom_behavior.site_detail: individual markers, labels and spatial overlays as needed

labels.default: label appears by priority/zoom, not on every marker
labels.collision: map engine collision handling required; never shrink typography ad hoc

routes_areas.journey_route: line/path + direction/progress cues; markers identify stops
routes_areas.historical_extent: area/polygon + label/legend; never encode certainty only by opacity
routes_areas.then_now: paired spatial state with explicit Then/Now labels or control

accessibility.keyboard: focusable interactive markers with meaningful accessible names
accessibility.screen_reader: entity type + name + state, e.g. Place: Imperial Citadel — visited
